notes.title: Avernum 4: Greed and Glory Out For Windows/Mac on October 22nd!
notes.content: [p]Started in 1994, the cult classic Avernum series is one of the great video game sagas. On October 22, Spiderweb Software returns to this unique underworld nation with Avernum 4: Greed and Glory! Coming for Windows and Mac. [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3882020/Avernum_4_Greed_and_Glory/"]Take a look here![/url][/p][p][/p][p]In this new, epic fantasy role-playing adventure, you explore and save (or betray?) an enormous underworld nation. Battle through huge dungeons, fight unique and cunning foes, collect, create, and bless hundreds of different artifacts, and enjoy a really cool story. [/p][p align="start"][/p][p]Avernum is a nation deep underground, full of huge caves, treacherous labyrinths, and fairylands of alien fungi. Once a prison, it has won its freedom and is now reaching for wealth and glory. However, old enemies from the deepest caves envy Avernum's growing power. You will have to fight to save this new, fragile land (or be well paid to betray it).[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]You can see an Avernum 4 trailer, screenshots, and plenty of information on our web site or on our Steam page. If you are interested, please [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3882020/Avernum_4_Greed_and_Glory/"]wishlist the game on Steam[/url]. It helps a lot! [/p]

notes.title: Geneforge 2 - Infestation Kickstarter Launched!
notes.content:
We have [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/spiderwebsoftware/geneforge-2-infestation]launched a Kickstarter[/url] for our next title, a full remaster of Geneforge 2, released wayyyy back in 2003. Geneforge 2 - Infestation will be the second chapter in the reborn Geneforge Saga. We want to go over it and redo everything, adding new characters, quests, monsters to create, and training paths to scorch (or save) the mountains of Drypeak.

We’re really excited about the remasters. The first one, Geneforge 1 - Mutagen, is our best-selling game in a long time, and its follow-up will have a lot of fun new stuff to keep the series fresh for newcomers and old fans alike. The Kickstarter will run for a month, and it has a mix of old and new stretch goals and rewards. Backers can still add content to the game (an experiment which has been a huge success), and, for the first time, you can now get physical Spiderweb merch.

We can only still make our odd little games with the support of our fans, and we're hugely grateful. Come check out the new Kickstarter here ...

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/spiderwebsoftware/geneforge-2-infestation

- Jeff Vogel
Spiderweb Software

notes.title: Queen's Wish 2: The Tormentor Announced, New RPG From Spiderweb Software!
notes.content:
Queen's Wish 2: The Tormentor is the second chapter in the indie, epic Queen’s Wish Trilogy. You are royalty of the Empire of Haven. A routine diplomatic mission in a brutal, barbarian land has turned into bloody chaos. Fight to calm your subjects, or hunt for a way to set them free.

Explore a vast nation full of cities, forts, and dungeons. Fight clever, carefully designed turn-based battles. Deal with misbehaving vassals with bribery, diplomacy, or violence. Build new forts and customize them, choosing among upgrades that give your adventurers powerful bonuses.

Spiderweb Software is back! Our next, all-new game, Queen's Wish 2: The Tormentor, is coming to Windows and Macintosh at the end of Summer, 2022. 

Queen's Wish 2: The Tormentor will be taking part in Steam Next Fest, June 13-20. You can try out the demo, and heckle us during our developer livestreams.

Drop by the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1947750/Queens_Wish_2_The_Tormentor/]game page[/url] and wishlist it if you want to be informed when it comes out!

notes.title: Major Queen's Wish Update!
notes.content:
We have updated Queen's Wish: The Conqueror to v1.1. The new version has completely revamped creature graphics and lots of small improvements. They're great improvements for our retro indie adventure.

We just had a successful Kickstarter for the next game in the Queen's Wish trilogy, Queen's Wish 2: The Tormentor. Part of the funds for that are going into improved graphics, and we wanted to get that art into the first game. 

Queen's Wish 2 should be out in 2022. Enjoy!

notes.title: Queen's Wish v1.1 Major Update!
notes.content:
This major update completely reworks the creature graphics and makes them much nicer. There are also a number of minor tweaks and fixes.

We just had a hugely successful Kickstarter for Queen's Wish 2: The Tormentor. We got a bunch of nice new art, and we're putting it in Queen's Wish as well. Enjoy!

notes.title: Queen's Wish 2: The Tormentor Kickstarter!
notes.content:
We are ready to create [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/spiderwebsoftware/queens-wish-2-the-tormentor]Queen’s Wish 2: The Tormentor[/url], the sequel to Queen's Wish: The Conqueror, and we’re asking for your help! In the second game in the Queen’s Wish series, you are still royalty of the Empire of Haven. You have been sent on countless boring missions to remote nations. But your mother has fallen desperately ill, and your enemies sense weakness. Your mother has commanded that you quiet a rebellion in the wild, violent land of the Rokaj. Now you are trapped in icy mountains, surrounded by angry armies and factions shouting for your support. Doom creeps ever closer, and the demands of your family are constant. They say you must conquer the Rokaj. 

Will you? Or will you set it free? It is up to you.

Queen’s Wish 2 will use a redesigned, improved version of Queen’s Wish: The Conqueror engine and have a huge world and tons of new abilities and ways to customize your Empire. Our Kickstarter will fund the game, including buying new art and other resources. The Kickstarter has many rewards, including being listed in the credits, getting all sorts of goodies, and being able to help design the game. We greatly appreciate all your support!

The Kickstarter can be found at:

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/spiderwebsoftware/queens-wish-2-the-tormentor

notes.title: Geneforge 1 - Mutagen Released!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1424710/Geneforge_1__Mutagen/]Geneforge 1 - Mutagen[/url] is now out for Windows & Macintosh! It is the first game in a new epic series from Spiderweb Software. It's a unique, truly open-ended fantasy role-playing adventure in a strange, new world. Over 80 zones to explore and 50+ hours of gameplay. Multitudes of skills, abilities, factions, treasures, and servants to create.

Our game offers unmatched freedom in how you play. Use magic or your deadly pets to crush your enemies. Or, use trickery, diplomacy, and stealth to win the game without ever attacking a foe. Choose between a host of rival factions or just destroy everything. Defeat the final boss, or switch sides and join him. Fight alone with blades, missiles, or magic, or create your own army of custom-made mutant monsters.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1424710/Geneforge_1__Mutagen/]Geneforge 1 - Mutagen[/url] is a full remaster of our cult-classic indie hit Geneforge, released in 2001. The new version has been completely redone. Every encounter, every item, every line of dialogue. There are new regions, quests, artifacts, skills, and storylines.

notes.title: Queen's Wish v1.0.2 Update Released!
notes.content:
Our new fantasy epic, Queen's Wish: The Conqueror, has been out several weeks, and the response has been fantastic! Sales and reviews have been great, and we are already starting to plan Queen's Wish 2. We are so grateful to be able to keep writing this trilogy!

We have updated Queen's Wish: The Conqueror to v1.0.2. It's a major update that includes a host of bug fixes, balance changes, and better performance. Thank you again for all your support!

notes.title: Queen's Wish: The Conqueror rallies the peasants for an autumn launch
notes.content:
So long as there exists a market for ’90s style party-managing RPGs, Spiderweb Software and its mostly-solo designer Jeff Vogel will be there. The studio’s next fantasy strategy RPG, Queen’s Wish: The Conqueror, is near-ish to completion, and while anything can happen in the wacky world of game dev, Spiderweb reckon it’ll be out this autumn. The first in a potential series (having concluded the stories of Geneforge, Avernum and Avadon), it’s the story of a young royal leader fighting to get into their family’s good books by reviving a lost colony. Below, a new trailer.
